items.text: The accelerated format cuts the summer internship and roughly halves your networking and exploration runway compared to a 2-year program.

blocks.heading: Pass the Three Proofs Before You Apply

items.text: Before you spend a season preparing an application or a coaching fee on a 1-year program, run yourself through the three proofs, the same proof-of-skill, proof-of-communication, proof-of-value test worth applying to any expensive, time-bound career decision.
Do not commit to an application cycle before passing all three proofs.
A 1-year MBA is built to compress classroom learning around people who already carry live case material from their own careers.

No summer internship in most formats, the compressed academic calendar leaves no gap for one, though some institutes add mentorship or short project modules instead

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: Say you are earning ₹18 lakh a year before enrolling.

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: A 1-year program at ₹40 lakh in fees costs you roughly ₹18 lakh in foregone salary for a single year, a real total closer to ₹58 lakh. At this income level, the two formats land in a similar real-cost zone, and the deciding factor becomes how much each format's outcome actually moves your career, not the sticker price.

figures.label: Total Education Cost
figures.source: A 1-year MBA at ₹35-42 lakh looks more expensive than a 2-year MBA at ₹25-27 lakh on the fee line alone.

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: Now run the same math at ₹35 lakh a year, a realistic pre-MBA income for someone eligible for IIM Ahmedabad's PGPX.

blocks.heading: Course Fees and the 10 Percent Test

figures.label: Total Education Cost
figures.source: The fee gap between a 1-year and a 2-year MBA looks like roughly ₹10-15 lakh in the 1-year format's disfavour. But that gap only tells half the story, the other half is how many years of salary you are giving up to earn each degree, which is where the real comparison shifts.

figures.label: Education Budget Example
figures.source: An illustration, not a real fee: on a Rs 5 lakh education budget, a tenth is Rs 50,000 for the main course, and a fifth is Rs 1 lakh as a serious caution. The rest can fund a laptop, practice time and a reserve.

figures.label: Allocated Budget Share
figures.source: As a strict planning rule, weigh either fee against roughly 10% of your total education and upskilling budget for the years ahead.
